prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ describeReading }`. It accepts a record `{ hour, condition, temperature, feelsLike, windSpeed, windDegrees, pressure, humidity }`. `hour` must be an integer from 0 through 23; condition must be a string; all other fields must be finite numbers, with windSpeed and humidity non-negative and humidity at most 100. Invalid input throws `TypeError`. Conditions are normalized by trimming and lowercasing. Return a new record with: `time` in 12-hour `hh:00 AM/PM` form; `icon` selected from `clear-day`, `clear-night`, `cloud-day`, `cloud-night`, or `unknown` (clear and cloudy/overcast are recognized); the four temperature/pressure values unchanged; `windRotation` equal to degrees normalized into `[0,360)`; `windScale` equal to `1 + min(windSpeed, 40) / 40`; and `moistureScale` equal to `0.5 + humidity / 200`. Daytime is hours 6 through 17 inclusive. Do not mutate the input.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
